correctness.rationale: For x>0 the killed two-state resolvent satisfies D K″+QK-rK=-rI, open Dirichlet and closed Neumann boundaries. The explicit two-mode bounded solution is K=(I-fe_open^T)P with strictly ordered 0<f0<f1<1. Its positive sub-stochastic entries yield two simple positive eigenvalues below 1. Direct matrix identities det(I-K)=(1-t)fbar and det(sI-K)=-pt(f1-f0)fbar place the stationary one-attempt survival s between these eigenvalues, making both mixture weights strictly positive. Strong Markov at resets gives the exact geometric mixture. Its strict hazard decay and variance defect follow algebraically; symbolic and independent finite-difference checks corroborate the proof, with no reliance on finite experiments for universal quantifiers.

value.rationale: A count of interventions before successful target binding measures effort and finite reset budget; the 2023 finite-budget literature makes this physically motivated rather than arbitrary. The exact two-geometric law, declining capture hazard, and universal positive variance gap quantify hidden gate persistence and demonstrate systematic underestimation by naive independent-attempt geometric models. The result holds over the full strictly positive physical parameter domain and gives explicit measurable formulas.
